summary.text: Terisiare enters the Thaw as its icy shell melts and most inhabitants rejoice, but a secretive society of mages, the Cult of Rimewind, seeks to use the time of change to shroud the continent in its icy magic.
Heidar finds Phyrexian etchings in Rimewind Keep and goes mad, murdering Gendrin and taking command, and he attacks Kjeld with reclaimed Phyrexian war machines.
Kjeldor and the Yavimayan elves defeat the cult's beasts, Garza Zol's assassins kill Heidar, and a ritual ends the unnatural winter, restoring the Thaw.
